# FortiGate (FortiOS) conversion from PAN-OS
config system global
    set hostname "PA-SYN-01"
end
# ---- Interfaces
config system interface
    edit "port1"
        set vdom "root"
        set mode static
        set ip 198.51.100.2 255.255.255.248
        set allowaccess ping
        set description "uplink"
    next
    edit "port2"
        set vdom "root"
        set mode static
        set ip 10.1.0.1 255.255.255.0
        set allowaccess ping https ssh
    next
    edit "vlan20"
        set vdom "root"
        set interface "port2"
        set vlanid 20
        set mode static
        set ip 10.1.20.1 255.255.255.0
    next
    edit "port3"
        set vdom "root"
        set mode static
        set ip 10.2.0.1 255.255.255.0
    next
    edit "agg1"
        set vdom "root"
        set type aggregate
        set member "port4" "port5"
        set lacp-mode active
        set mode static
        set ip 10.3.0.1 255.255.255.0
    next
    edit "lo1"
        set vdom "root"
        set type loopback
        set mode static
        set ip 10.255.1.1 255.255.255.255
    next
end
# ---- Site-to-site VPN
config vpn ipsec phase1-interface
    edit "tun-remote"
        set interface "port1"
        set ike-version 2
        set proposal aes256-sha256 aes256-sha384 aes128-sha256 aes128-sha384
        set dhgrp 14 19
        set remote-gw 203.0.113.50
        set keylife 28800
        set nattraversal enable
        set dpd on-demand
        set psksecret REPLACE-ME
    next
end
config vpn ipsec phase2-interface
    edit "tun-remote-p2-1"
        set phase1name "tun-remote"
        set proposal aes256gcm
        set pfs enable
        set dhgrp 19
        set keylifeseconds 3600
        set src-subnet 10.1.0.0 255.255.255.0
        set dst-subnet 10.50.0.0 255.255.0.0
    next
end
# ---- Zones
config system zone
    edit "untrust"
        set intrazone allow
        set interface "port1"
    next
    edit "trust"
        set intrazone allow
        set interface "port2" "vlan20" "agg1"
    next
    edit "dmz"
        set intrazone allow
        set interface "port3"
    next
    edit "vpn"
        set intrazone allow
        set interface "tun-remote"
    next
end
# ---- Objects
config firewall address
    edit "srv-web"
        set subnet 10.2.0.10 255.255.255.255
    next
    edit "srv-range"
        set type iprange
        set start-ip 10.2.0.20
        set end-ip 10.2.0.29
    next
    edit "lan"
        set subnet 10.1.0.0 255.255.255.0
    next
    edit "ext-web"
        set subnet 198.51.100.4 255.255.255.255
    next
    edit "partner"
        set type fqdn
        set fqdn "partner.example.test"
    next
    edit "remote-lan"
        set subnet 10.50.0.0 255.255.0.0
    next
    edit "geo-KP"
        set type geography
        set country "KP"
        set comment "region KP"
    next
    edit "geo-RU"
        set type geography
        set country "RU"
        set comment "region RU"
    next
end
config firewall addrgrp
    edit "servers"
        set member "srv-web" "srv-range"
    next
end
config firewall service custom
    edit "tcp-8443"
        set tcp-portrange 8443
    next
    edit "dns-src"
        set udp-portrange 53:1024-65535
    next
    edit "service-https"
        set tcp-portrange 443
        set comment "predefined PAN-OS service"
    next
end
config firewall service group
    edit "web-svcs"
        set member "tcp-8443" "service-https"
    next
end
config firewall vip
    edit "vip-inbound-web"
        set extip 198.51.100.4
        set mappedip "10.2.0.10"
        set extintf "port1"
        set portforward enable
        set protocol tcp
        set extport 8443
        set mappedport 443
    next
end
config firewall ippool
    edit "pool-dmz-pool"
        set type overload
        set startip 198.51.100.6
        set endip 198.51.100.6
    next
end
# ---- Firewall policy
config firewall policy
    edit 1
        set name "allow-web"
        set srcintf "trust"
        set dstintf "untrust"
        set srcaddr "lan"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set action accept
        set schedule "always"
        set service "HTTPS" "HTTP"
        set logtraffic all
        set comments "PAN-OS applications: ssl, web-browsing; source rule allow-web"
    next
    edit 2
        set name "in-web"
        set srcintf "untrust"
        set dstintf "dmz"
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "vip-inbound-web"
        set action accept
        set schedule "always"
        set service "web-svcs"
        set logtraffic all
        set comments "source rule in-web"
    next
    edit 3
        set name "block-geo"
        set srcintf "untrust"
        set dstintf "any"
        set srcaddr "geo-KP" "geo-RU"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set action deny
        set schedule "always"
        set service "ALL"
        set logtraffic all
        set comments "source rule block-geo"
    next
    edit 4
        set name "social"
        set srcintf "trust"
        set dstintf "untrust"
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set action accept
        set schedule "always"
        set service "ALL"
        set logtraffic all
        set status disable
        set comments "NOT ENABLED: application facebook-base (App-ID); PAN-OS applications: facebook-base; source rule social"
    next
    edit 5
        set name "admins"
        set srcintf "trust"
        set dstintf "dmz"
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "servers"
        set action accept
        set schedule "always"
        set service "service-https" "dns-src"
        set logtraffic all
        set status disable
        set comments "source rule admins"
    next
    edit 6
        set name "ping"
        set srcintf "trust"
        set dstintf "any"
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set action accept
        set schedule "always"
        set service "PING"
        set logtraffic all
        set comments "PAN-OS applications: ping; source rule ping"
    next
    edit 7
        set name "vpn-out"
        set srcintf "trust"
        set dstintf "vpn"
        set srcaddr "lan"
        set dstaddr "remote-lan"
        set action accept
        set schedule "always"
        set service "ALL"
        set logtraffic all
        set comments "source rule vpn-out"
    next
end
config firewall central-snat-map
    edit 1
        set type ipv4
        set status enable
        set srcintf "trust"
        set dstintf "vpn"
        set orig-addr "lan"
        set dst-addr "remote-lan"
        set nat disable
    next
    edit 2
        set type ipv4
        set status enable
        set srcintf "trust"
        set dstintf "untrust"
        set orig-addr "lan"
        set dst-addr "all"
        set nat enable
    next
    edit 3
        set type ipv4
        set status enable
        set srcintf "dmz"
        set dstintf "untrust"
        set orig-addr "srv-web"
        set dst-addr "all"
        set nat enable
        set nat-ippool "pool-dmz-pool"
    next
end
config system settings
    set central-nat enable
end
# ---- Routing
config router static
    edit 1
        set gateway 198.51.100.1
        set device "port1"
        set distance 10
        set priority 10
    next
    edit 2
        set dst 10.50.0.0 255.255.0.0
        set device "tun-remote"
        set distance 10
        set priority 10
    next
    edit 3
        set dst 192.0.2.0 255.255.255.0
        set blackhole enable
        set distance 10
        set priority 10
    next
    edit 4
        set dst 10.77.0.0 255.255.0.0
        set gateway 10.1.0.254
        set device "port2"
        set distance 10
        set priority 10
    next
end
config router bgp
    set as 65020
    set router-id 10.255.1.1
    config neighbor
        edit "198.51.100.1"
            set remote-as 64512
            set description "isp"
        next
    end
end
config router ospf
    set router-id 10.255.1.1
    config area
        edit 0.0.0.0
        next
    end
    config network
        edit 1
            set prefix 10.3.0.0 255.255.255.0
            set area 0.0.0.0
        next
    end
end
